name: KDE Plasma & Desktop Control
description: Controls applications, audio volume, display brightness, network status, notifications, and session power in KDE Plasma.

tools.name: desktop_environment_info
tools.description: Inspect active display server (Wayland/X11), desktop session, and available KDE/D-Bus tools.

tools.name: send_notification
tools.description: Display a desktop notification via org.freedesktop.Notifications (notify-send).

tools.name: launch_application
tools.description: Launch an installed desktop application by desktop entry ID (e.g. org.kde.dolphin).

tools.name: set_volume
tools.description: Set master audio output volume percentage (0 to 100) via PipeWire/PulseAudio/ALSA.

tools.name: set_brightness
tools.description: Set screen backlight brightness percentage (5 to 100).

tools.name: network_status
tools.description: Inspect active network interfaces, local IP addresses, and routing status.
